blocks.text: As it can be seen from the above explanations English tenses may be rendered in Russian by either the imperfective or the perfective aspect of the corresponding Russian verbs. However, the following hints may be helpful:

head: English
Russian
rows: 2. Present Perfect Progressive: I have been writing all morning.
Present, imperfective: Я пишу уже всё утро. («уже» usually added)
3. Any progressive tense: I am writing a letter. I was writing a letter. I will be writing a letter.
Imperfective aspect of the corresponding verb: Я пишу письмо. Я писал письмо. Я буду писать письмо.

items: Она бесконечно говорила.
She was talking all the time.
Пара шла рука об руку.
The couple was walking arm in arm.
Дэниэл смотрел в окно.
Daniel was looking out the window.
Он жил со своей тётей.
He was living with his aunt.
Том сидел под яблоней.
Tom was sitting below an apple tree.
Писк стоял оглушающий.
The squeaking was deafening.
Эта пара влюблённых продолжала пылкую переписку.
This pair of lovers were carrying on an ardent correspondence.
Мальчик глядел на стаю карпов в пруду.
The boy was gazing at a school of carp in the pond.
Я чувствовал за собой слежку.
I felt I was being spied on.
Они лежали на лужайке.
They were lying on the grass.
Он ходил туда-сюда по перрону.
He was walking up and down the station platform.
Они не слушали музыку.
They were not listening to music.
